Mighty Lemon Drop Martini
By: Desiree Mellon
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




6 ounces lemon vodka
2 ounces cointreau, or, Triple Sec
4 tablespoons freshly squeezed lemon juice
2 teaspoons simple syrup, or, to taste
2 cups ice
1 lemon, or, candy lemon drops, jelly 
Preparation

1 Fill a martini shaker or a large glass with ice. Add vodka, Cointreau, lemon juice and simple syrup and shake or stir. Strain into chilled martini glasses. Garnish with a candy lemon drop or a lemon twist.
